 HoopsHype Nov. 15, 2026, 5:10 a.m. ET Michael Porter Jr. attended Saturday’s game after missing time for personal reasons. Fernández was asked about Porter’s absence and whether he knew when the forward might return, but the coach declined. “No, we want to give him his privacy. Everything, it’s fine. So, we’re happy that he was here,” Fernández said .
